description: Validate a synthetic, identity-free conversion event against the Plainrouter schema. Requires no account, API key, or OAuth flow. Nothing is stored and nothing is sent to an advertising provider. Use this to confirm the server is reachable and that an event payload is well formed before requesting credentials.

action_source.description: Where the synthetic event originated: website, app, or other.

event_id.description: Optional synthetic idempotency key. Maximum 128 characters. One is derived when omitted.

event_name.description: Synthetic event name, such as Purchase. Maximum 100 characters.

value_data.description: Optional synthetic commerce data. Identity-bearing fields are rejected.

currency.description: Three-letter uppercase ISO 4217 code such as EUR.

name: validate_sandbox_event
title: Validate Sandbox Event
